a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan almost certainly ends with both of us empty. The reserve only holds 4, enough for one unit. I plan to take 4 in round 1, so I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both end up short. If you'd rather propose another way, say so.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement. If there's no storm, I'll operate every round from now on so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take any more.
